WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.team_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN mh.g IS NOT NULL AND mh.w IS NOT NULL AND mh.g <> 0
                 THEN 1.0 * mh.w / mh.g END) AS avg_win_rate,
        COUNT(mh.team_id) AS record_count
    FROM team AS t
    LEFT JOIN manager_half AS mh
        ON mh.team_id = t.team_id
    GROUP BY t.team_id
),
league_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_win_rate
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT
    ta.team_id,
    ta.avg_win_rate,
    ta.record_count,
    ta.avg_win_rate - lm.mean_win_rate AS difference_from_mean
FROM team_averages AS ta
CROSS JOIN league_mean AS lm
WHERE lm.mean_win_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Teams are identified by team_id, so records are grouped and joined by that column across all years; AVG ignores records with missing wins or games and avoids division by zero.
